caseName: Wisconsin Electric Co. v. Dumore Co.
caseNameFull: Wisconsin Electric Co. v. Dumore Co.
attorneys: Mr. George Bayard Jones, with whom Messrs. Walter F. Murray and Greer Maréchál were on the brief, for petitioner. No appearance for respondent.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam:

It appearing that the asserted conflict in decisions arises from differences in states of fact, and not in the application of a principle of law, the writ of certiorari is dismissed as improvidently granted.
